title: Rowlett Lions Club gives nearly $46,000 back to the community
excerpt: In its latest fiscal year, the club sent $45,920 to kids, families and students across Rowlett.
coverAlt: Neighbors helping neighbors: $45,920 given back to Rowlett
body:
The Rowlett Lions Club has been serving this town since 1966, and this year it had a lot to show for it.

In the fiscal year that ended June 30, the club donated $45,920 to local charities, scholarships and community programs. Here's where it went:

- Texas Lions Camp for Children with Disabilities
- Lions Sight & Tissue Foundation
- Rowlett Needy Children's Fund
- Society of St. Vincent de Paul in Rowlett
- Hope in Hand Food Pantry at First Christian Church of Rowlett
- Scholarships for Rowlett High School students

That's food on tables, camp for kids who might not otherwise go, and a head start for graduating seniors – all from neighbors who decided to show up.

Want to be part of it? The Rowlett Lions Club meets at 6:30 p.m. on the second Monday of every month at Tokyo Hana in Rowlett.
